page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features an x86_64 architecture with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a resource density of 4.0 GB per core.

The instance integrates a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not included, requiring the use of network-attached storage options. Network performance is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and the configuration does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This instance represents an entry-level GPU configuration, offering dedicated CPU resources to avoid multi-tenant performance degradation. It is designed for workloads such as lightweight machine learning inference, video transcoding, and basic parallel processing tasks that require GPU acceleration but do not demand large system memory or high-speed local storage.
